entries.definition:
quixotic
     adj : not sensible about practical matters; unrealistic; "as
           quixotic as a restoration of medieval knighthood"; "a
           romantic disregard for money"; "a wild-eyed dream of a
           world state" [syn: {romantic}, {wild-eyed}]

a.
1 resemble or characteristic of the Spanish chivalric hero (w: Don Quixote); possessed with or resulting from the desire to do noble and romantic deeds, without thought of realism and practicality.
2 Overly optimistic and moralistic.
3 Exceedingly idealistic.
n.
(lb en rare) A quixotic person or sentiment.
